info.title: Private Fax Processing API
info.description: Replace the host and OAuth tenant/API settings before importing. Requires approved Power Platform private connectivity. Fax.Submit authorizes upload; Fax.Admin authorizes cross-owner status reads. File uploads are raw binary, not base64 text.

scopes.api://REPLACE_API_CLIENT_ID/access_as_us: Access the Fax API as the signed-in user

post.summary: Upload a fax for asynchronous processing
post.description: Requires Fax.Submit. Reuse the same idempotency UUID when retrying the same file and source. A 202 response is an upload receipt, not a successful extraction.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Submission UUID generated once and reused on retries.

parameters.name: X-Fax-Source
parameters.description: Configured source authorized for this connection identity.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Raw PDF or TIFF file bytes.

202.description: Accepted for asynchronous processing. See API documentation for the receipt shape.

statusUrl.description: Relative path to the status API.

400.description: Invalid input, missing header, unsupported media type or mismatched file signature

401.description: Missing or invalid Entra access token

409.description: Idempotency key conflicts with an existing submission

413.description: Empty upload or upload exceeds configured byte limit

503.description: Admission disabled or service temporarily unavailable

get.summary: Read an authorized fax job status
get.description: Only the submission owner or a caller with Fax.Admin or Fax.Review may read the job. Consumers must use a completed manifest and verify the listed artifact hashes, not consume an individual blob on arrival. This connector covers upload/status only; review and reporting endpoints are documented separately.

200.description: Authorized job status. See API documentation for the status shape.

404.description: Job not found or caller lacks ownership, Fax.Admin and Fax.Review
